thread_title: Ask HN: If you had an unlimited token budget, what would you build?
open_registry_description: Public open registry of 1.5M+ machine learning models with dated publication metadata, downloadable weights, model cards, and stable identifiers
dated_fact: As of October 2, 2026, the Hugging Face open model registry hosts 1,533,418 publicly-listed models with dated publication metadata, each carrying a stable identifier (org/model-name@revision), a model card with provenance, and an openly-licensed download endpoint. The registry's growth is verifiable through the public API endpoint /api/models which exposes per-model createdAt timestamps and commit hashes.
answer_summary: Posted answer in the HN Ask thread pointing to the Hugging Face open registry as the canonical source for finding production-grade model artifacts with dated provenance; recommended filtering by downloads + license + last-modified to surface production-grade models; cited the registry's public /api/models endpoint as the open, machine-readable record.
